outcome: Give asset integrity director / production manager a governed method to improve disputed JV allocation amount using AFE budgets, invoices and entitlement allocations, with final decisions retained…
overview: Joint Venture Cost Allocation Audit addresses resource allocation is planned in silos, producing avoidable delays and occasionally infeasible instructions in oil, gas and petrochemicals operations. The first proof of value uses AFE budgets, invoices and entitlement allocations. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is disputed JV allocation amount, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: AFE budgets, invoices and entitlement allocations; define disputed JV allocation amount and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Asset Integrity Director / Production Manager.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including replay disruption and edge cases with hard constraints enforced.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for disputed JV allocation amount
